subject: Invoice 2027-4471 — overdue reminder
body: Dear Sir or Madam, our invoice 2027-4471 for terminal cleaning consumables (EUR 4,380.00) was due on 15 February and remains unpaid. Please confirm the payment date. Bank details as per contract.

subject: Фактура 10023 — канцеларски материали
body: Здравейте, прилагаме фактура 10023 на стойност 1 240,50 лв. за доставка на канцеларски материали от 26 февруари. Моля за потвърждение на получаването.

subject: Unacceptable queue at security on 28 February
body: I waited 48 minutes at security on Saturday morning and nearly missed flight FR1234. There were two lanes open at the busiest hour. I would like an explanation and to know what you intend to do about it.

subject: Оплакване — чакане за багаж 55 минути
body: Пристигнах в неделя вечер и чаках багажа си 55 минути на лента 2. Никой не даде информация. Моля за отговор защо се случва това.

subject: Left my laptop charger at gate B4
body: I think I left a black laptop charger in the seating area at gate B4 yesterday evening, around 19:30, before flight to Lisbon. Is there a way to check if it was found?

subject: Изгубени очила в зала заминаване
body: Забравих очила с кафяви рамки на масата в кафенето след проверката за сигурност, около 14 ч. в събота. Как мога да проверя дали са намерени?

subject: Stand request — ferry flight 4 March
body: Good morning, we have a ferry flight arriving 04 March at 06:40 and request a remote stand with GPU availability for approximately four hours. Please confirm.

subject: Additional check-in desks for summer season
body: For the summer schedule we expect two additional rotations on Tuesday and Thursday mornings and will need two further check-in desks between 04:30 and 07:00. Who should we address the formal request to?

subject: Въпрос относно пренасяне на отпуск
body: Здравейте, имам 6 неизползвани дни отпуск от миналата година. Може ли да ги пренеса и до кога трябва да ги ползвам?

subject: Passenger numbers Q1 — request for comment
body: I am preparing an article on regional airport growth and would like your Q1 passenger figures and a short comment from management. My deadline is Thursday 17:00.

subject: AI chatbot for airports — 15 minutes?
body: Hi, we deploy conversational AI for airports and have reduced call volumes by 40% at three European airports. Would you have 15 minutes next week for a short demo?

subject: Rooftop solar potential at your terminals
body: Dear team, we specialise in rooftop photovoltaic installations for transport infrastructure and would welcome the chance to present our approach. Attached is our company profile.

subject: Неработещ ескалатор до изход A12
body: Ескалаторът към изход A12 не работи от снощи. Пътниците използват стълбите, а има и хора с багаж. Моля за реакция.

subject: Charged twice for pre-booked parking
body: I pre-booked parking online (booking 88231) but the barrier did not open and I had to take a ticket. I have now been charged twice. Please refund the second charge.

subject: Такси от летището — надписана цена
body: Платих 48 лв. за курс до центъра, който обикновено струва 20 лв. Таксито беше взето от стоянката пред Терминал 2. Какво правите по този въпрос?

subject: Wheelchair assistance request for 19 March
body: My father flies on 19 March, arriving 11:20, and will need wheelchair assistance from the aircraft to the arrivals hall. He has limited mobility but can walk a few steps. How do we arrange this?

subject: Delivery access hours for airside unit
body: We would like to change our delivery slot from 05:00 to 04:30 to be ready before the first wave. What is the process and who approves it?

subject: Проблем с подаването на данни за продажби
body: От 28 февруари системата ни не изпраща автоматично дневните продажби към вашия портал. Изпращаме файловете ръчно. Моля за съдействие от ваша страна.

subject: Master's thesis — questions on airport sustainability
body: I am writing a thesis on decarbonisation at mid-sized European airports and would be grateful for ten minutes with someone from your team, or answers to five written questions.

subject: Your mailbox will be deactivated within 24 hours
body: Your mailbox has exceeded its storage quota and will be deactivated. Click here to verify your credentials and restore full access immediately.

subject: RE: Invoice 2027-4471 — second reminder
body: Following our message this morning, we still have no confirmation on invoice 2027-4471. Please advise whether the invoice was received by your finance department.

subject: Разлято масло на перона до позиция 7
body: Констатирано разливане на масло около позиция 7, приблизително 2 кв. м. Зоната е временно обозначена. Необходимо е почистване и регистриране на случая.

subject: Compensation claim — 3 hour delay on 26 February
body: My flight on 26 February was delayed by three hours and twenty minutes. Under EU261 I am entitled to 250 EUR compensation. Please confirm how you will process this claim.

subject: Отношение на служител на проверка за сигурност
body: Служителка на проверката за сигурност ми говори грубо пред други пътници, защото не бях извадила лаптопа си. Очаквам извинение.

subject: Lost teddy bear — my daughter is inconsistent
body: We flew out on Sunday and our four-year-old left her brown teddy bear, probably at the gate A9 seating. She is heartbroken. Any chance it was handed in?

subject: Baggage belt stoppage this morning
body: Belt 3 stopped twice this morning for a total of around 25 minutes, which delayed two departures. Can maintenance review and let us know what happened?

subject: Запитване за дата на плащане
body: Моля да потвърдите кога ще бъде платена фактура 2027-0091 от 12 януари. Съгласно договора срокът беше 45 дни.

subject: Follow-up on my application — Maintenance Technician
body: I applied for the maintenance technician position three weeks ago and have not heard back. Could you let me know whether the position is still open?

subject: Digital advertising screens — partnership proposal
body: We would like to propose a revenue-share model for digital advertising screens in your departure area. Who handles commercial partnerships?

subject: Течности и покупки от дюти фрий при прекачване
body: Летя през Виена с покупка от дюти фрий от София. Ще ми вземат ли парфюма при втората проверка? Какво трябва да направя?

subject: Is there a pharmacy after security?
body: I fly on Friday evening and need to buy basic medication. Is there a pharmacy airside, and what are the opening hours?

subject: Dispute — deduction on invoice 884/2027
body: We note a deduction of EUR 1,100 on our February invoice without explanation. Please provide the basis for the deduction or arrange payment of the full amount.

subject: Неработеща тоалетна Терминал 2
body: Тоалетната до изход B10 е неизправна от сутринта — две от кабините не се заключват и няма сапун.

subject: Winter season contract — scope clarification
body: Before we quote for next winter we need clarification on expected fluid volumes and whether pad allocation remains as last season. Can we arrange a call?

subject: Filming permission request — 11 March
body: We would like to film a short segment in the departures hall on 11 March between 09:00 and 11:00, with one camera operator and one reporter. What is the approval process?

subject: Изгубен паспорт в зоната за заминаване
body: Вчера вечерта изгубих български паспорт някъде между проверката за сигурност и изход A6. Летя отново в петък. Какво да направя?

subject: Reduce your Microsoft licensing spend
body: We help infrastructure operators optimise Microsoft licensing and typically identify 18% savings. May I send a short overview?

subject: 40 minute wait for wheelchair assistance
body: My wife waited 40 minutes at the aircraft for assistance on arrival last Thursday. She has a heart condition and found this very distressing. This needs to be looked at.

subject: Достъп до системи за нов служител
body: От понеделник започва нов колега в отдел Поддръжка. Моля за създаване на профил, достъп до CMMS и служебна поща.

subject: Question about yesterday
body: Hello, I was at the airport yesterday and something happened that I want to discuss. Can someone call me back? My number is in my signature.
